Lucide icons, version 1.53.0, matching the Gloss reference.

SVG geometry is extracted unchanged from lucide-react icon nodes, with the
default 24px view box, 2px round strokes, and no fill.
Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/lucide-react/-/lucide-react-1.53.0.tgz
License: ISC (see LICENSE). Only the reader and header icons are included.
The bundled Tailwind plugin also provides lucide-thin-* variants using 1.5px
strokes for the quiet, consistently sized header controls.
